description:
Hi,


This is Anthony from Infojini Consulting. Hope you are doing well! 


We are looking for UI Front End Developer in Knoxville, TN for 12 months Contract.

 

 Job details mentioned below
Tile:UI Front End Developer

Duration: 12 Months initially

Location: Knoxville, TN

Client:Direct client


Descrip[tion:
The candidate must be able to demonstrate a proven track record of designing and writing excellent code and are encouraged to bring code samples for discussion. 

The candidate should exhibit an attitude of continuous learning. An ideal candidate will have experience with high-performance, high-scale web applications, 

test-driven development, and web concepts such as JSON, HTTP, HTML, CSS3 and REST


Responsibilities:

· Lead the UI development for a scrum team

· Contribute to the overall software development lifecycle including requirements gathering/analysis, design, development technologies, release/version 

control, testing, and deployment

· Perform application testing of components, modifications, and overall systems

· Assist in task planning, estimation and scheduling

· Review the work of other peers on project teams

· Work in close partnership with other team members and other teams to ensure Scripps UX standards and guidelines are utilized

· Mentor junior developers


 Education: College Degree in a technical or design field preferred or equivalent experience

Experience; Minimum 5 years’ experience of front-end development; Knowledge of JavaScript including frameworks (Bootstrap, Backbone.js, Ember.js, Angular.js).
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Groovy and Python
Fundamental understanding of web applications.
Experience in and success with Agile software development methodologies, especially Scrum and eXtreme Programming (XP)
Experience utilizing continuous integration environments, continuous delivery and TDD (test driven development)
Experience with Service Oriented Architectures such as ReST and Web Services; 
Contributor to the Open Source Community preferred
Experience with JavaScript
Experience with UI frameworks such as AngularJS
Experience unit testing JavaScript with testing frameworks such as Jasmine.




 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
